title: Token-context parity steward: runtime/tooling interoperability maintenance
creator: Maya Singh
description: Maintain and evolve the compatibility matrix that ensures tokenization, context window behaviors, and operator tooling remain interoperable across primary models and their fallback variants. This ticket covers: inventory refresh, automated parity tests, CI gates, migration runbooks for tokenizer updates, and a lightweight monitoring surface to detect regressions in routing fallbacks. Goal: reduce routing failovers caused by tokenizer/context mismatches to <0.01% of routed requests and shorten remediation time from detection to mitigation to under 2 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Automated parity tests (tokenization + context-length + special token handling) run in CI for every model variant PR
Compatibility matrix published and accessible to runtime routing service with versioned schema
Smoke canary that validates fallback chain before routing promotion for a new variant
Playbook for emergency remapping of fallback variants tested in staging and documented
Alerting configured for parity-drift signals with SLO-aligned thresholds
implementation_notes: Add tokenizer round-trip tests (encode->decode) that assert stable token IDs for 1000 representative prompts per language cohort
Introduce context-behavior tests: prefix preservation, kv-cache handshake, and forced-truncation semantics
Extend CI to run parity suite on quantized variants and on CPU-based local runners
Create a small compatibility API endpoint (/compat/v1/lookup) with cached matrix and TTL for routing service
Instrument routing to emit parity-failure metrics (model_a, model_b, prompt_hash, failure_type)
test_plan: Unit tests for tokenizer adapters and shim layers
Integration tests exercising real model artifacts (small sample of commits) in ephemeral infra
Canary rollouts: 1% traffic -> 10% -> 50% with automated rollback on parity or quality regressions
Nightly matrix sweep job that runs fast checks against model variants and posts results to Merge Request status
Chaos test: simulate truncated kv-cache responses and ensure fallbacks preserve correctness
rollout_plan: Stage: run matrix sweep in staging cluster and validate against stability thresholds
Canary: enable new variant for internal-only traffic and run end-to-end prompts from PROD prompt set
Gradual: increment traffic with observability gates every 30 minutes
Full: promote to routing pool after 24h of green metrics
Fallback: automap to previous compatible variant and notify on-call with runbook link

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Parity tests may be flaky with non-deterministic tokenizers -> Mitigation: lock seed lists and use deterministic tokenizer binaries in CI
Risk: Nightly sweep may generate noise and alarm fatigue -> Mitigation: tier alerts (info/warning/critical) and group by signal recurrence
Risk: Tooling shim could mask real incompatibilities -> Mitigation: require explicit opt-in and flag shimged variants in matrix
Risk: Large language set increases test cost -> Mitigation: sampling strategy with stratified cohorts based on traffic and error history
next_steps: Complete /compat/v1/lookup prototype and add TTL + schema versioning
Finish tokenizer round-trip normalization shim and add unit tests
Wire up nightly sweep job to CI and dashboard with historical trend charts
Run staging canary with internal prompt corpus and confirm rollback works end-to-end
